name: cozy-realistic

styleBlock.medium: Digital photograph shot in natural light; subtle film-emulation post-processing, warm-toned color grading and a light bloom/glow effect.
styleBlock.lines: No hard vector lines; soft, gradual edge transitions. Medium-to-high detail sharpness in the foreground, natural bokeh softening in the background; organic, photographic contours.

palette.role: warm cream / gold, main light color

styleBlock.light: Low-angle, warm golden-hour light; rim light from behind and the side, halo and glow where light passes through fuzzy or feathery surfaces; diffuse, soft light source with no hard shadow edges.
styleBlock.texture: Subtle organic film grain; smooth but not sterile-digital; a soft, almost pastel roughness.
styleBlock.contrast: Low-to-medium contrast with compressed dynamic range: highlights never blow out and shadows never fully close; overall soft and airy.
styleBlock.shading: Soft, diffused shadows with no harsh atmospheric shadow; shadows are tinted (dark greenish tones) and balanced by the warmth of the light; soft-light photographic shading, not chiaroscuro.

motionHints: steam rising slowly from a cup
fireplace or candle flames flickering gently
warm light pulsing softly on the walls
leaves and flowers swaying faintly in a breeze
dust motes drifting in a sunbeam
water flowing in a stream outside
